name: arcaid-2026-analysis-tables
title: ARCAID-2026 analysis tables
description: Tidy tables built from every ARC-AGI-3 save run of ARCAID-2026. Outcomes come from replaying each recorded action history on the official engine (arc-agi 0.9.8, arcengine 0.9.3); behaviour comes from the run logs. Join keys: run_id, game_run, pass, analysis_step, action_num (= actions.action_index).

resources.name: replay
resources.description: One row per game-run: the harness's record against the engine replay.

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: <notebook>@v<version> on Kaggle

fields.name: folder
fields.description: the run's folder in this repository

fields.name: place
fields.description: submissions | development | ablations | tools

fields.name: group
fields.description: ablation folder, if any

fields.name: arm
fields.description: arm within the ablation, if any

fields.name: game_run
fields.description: game id; level trials end in @L<k> (start level k, 0-based)

fields.name: trial
fields.description: 1 for a level trial

fields.name: replay_levels_completed
fields.description: engine count after the last action (absolute)

fields.name: actions_per_level_match
fields.description: whole-game runs only

fields.name: replay_score
fields.description: RHAE, whole-game runs only

resources.name: levels
resources.description: One row per level played: whole-game runs list every level up to the one they stopped on; a level trial lists its one level.

fields.name: level
fields.description: 0-based

fields.name: human_actions
fields.description: official baseline for the level

fields.name: our_actions
fields.description: actions taken on the level, RESETs included

fields.name: actions_over_human
fields.description: cleared levels only

fields.name: generated_tokens
fields.description: sum of the harness's per-action generated-token field on this level

resources.name: actions
resources.description: One row per action, replayed on the engine.

fields.name: action_index
fields.description: 1-based; joins events.action_num

fields.name: level
fields.description: 0-based level the action was taken on

fields.name: action
fields.description: RESET, ACTION1-ACTION7

fields.name: board_changed
fields.description: last frame after the action differs from the last frame before it

fields.name: board_hash
fields.description: first 12 hex of sha1 of the last frame after the action

fields.name: generated_tokens
fields.description: harness field

fields.name: wallclock_seconds
fields.description: harness field

resources.name: turns
resources.description: One row per model turn (analysis_step), from transcripts.

fields.name: finish_length
fields.description: responses cut by the token limit

fields.name: reads_code
fields.description: tool calls whose code contains current_frame.code

fields.name: reads_rules
fields.description: ... contains .rules

fields.name: calls_action
fields.description: tool calls whose code calls action(...)

fields.name: pf_nudge
fields.description: user prompts carrying the probe-first ledger

fields.name: lexicon_cue
fields.description: user prompts carrying a lexicon cue

resources.name: calls
resources.description: One row per model response, from the request logs (October runs onward).

resources.name: events
resources.description: One row per action as the harness logged it; links each action to its turn.

fields.name: level_completed
fields.description: as logged; a final-level win is logged as done, not level_completed

fields.name: level
fields.description: as logged (1-based)
